preamble.summary: Population-size swap: for SHADE, L-SHADE, L-SRTDE and jSO, the values of control_2026_10_continuous_bounce with the population parameter taken from tuned_2026_10_subset_combined. Run with EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_SET.

procedure.derived_from: control_2026_10_continuous_bounce (receiver) and tuned_2026_10_subset_combined (donor): params of each block, unchanged except the population parameter
procedure.group_meaning: SHADE population_factor (N = round(f D)), LSHADE pop_size_factor (N_init = round(f D)), LSRTDE population_factor (N_init = round(f D)), JSO population_coefficient (N_init = round(c ln(D) sqrt(D)))
procedure.unchanged_everywhere: every other parameter of the block (memory, archive, p-best, adaptation settings); the DE blocks take no constraint_handling_mode
procedure.values_tuned_on: none: a recombination of two tuned configurations, not a tuned set

preamble.selection: params = the receiver's first final elite with the donor's population parameter

fixed_settings.why: a setting no tuning run raced, written into every algorithm that takes it
